nodes.label: Produto data model (nome, quantidade, criado_em)
nodes.rationale: Model fields define validation and ModelForm applies it; no relationships or state transitions.

nodes.label: Implementation Plan: Product Registry Home

nodes.label: Feature Spec: Cadastro e Listagem de Produtos na Home
nodes.norm_label: feature spec: cadastro e listagem de produtos na home

nodes.label: Template autoescaping for safe output (R6)
nodes.rationale: Never use |safe or mark_safe on product data.

nodes.label: ModelForm with model-field validation (R3)
nodes.rationale: Validators on model fields; ModelForm strips whitespace and rejects decimals/text; one set of rules shared by DB and form.

nodes.label: Newest-first ordering via criado_em index (R5)
nodes.rationale: Meta.ordering ['-criado_em','-id'] with db_index; no pagination at 1,000 rows.

nodes.label: Post/Redirect/Get (R4)
nodes.rationale: A valid POST redirects (302) to / so reloading repeats a GET, preventing duplicates; messages framework shows one-time confirmation. Rendering on POST or tokens rejected.

nodes.label: pt-BR locale (R7)
nodes.rationale: LANGUAGE_CODE pt-br gives Portuguese built-in validation messages without custom strings.

nodes.label: SQLite default storage (R1)
nodes.rationale: User asked for default SQLite; few thousand rows single writer; PostgreSQL rejected as unnecessary service.

nodes.label: Claude Code @claude Mention Workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs Claude only when @claude is mentioned in issues, comments or reviews.

nodes.label: Issue Triage Workflow (Claude)
nodes.rationale: Automatically triages every newly opened issue with a structured comment: classification, affected files, subtasks, related issues, observations.

nodes.label: Mandatory Documentation Sync (doc-sync-onboarding)
nodes.rationale: Every code change must end by running the doc-sync-onboarding agent to update CLAUDE.md and docs/.

nodes.label: ModelSerializer
nodes.rationale: Explicit fields list; avoid __all__ which exposes sensitive fields.

nodes.label: Bulk Operations (bulk_create/bulk_update/update)
nodes.rationale: Replace N queries with 1 query.

nodes.label: N+1 Query Problem
nodes.rationale: Accessing related objects in loops triggers 1+N queries; fix with select_related (FK/1:1 JOIN) or prefetch_related (M2M/reverse FK, separate query).

nodes.label: Critical Production Settings (SECRET_KEY, DEBUG, ALLOWED_HOSTS)
nodes.rationale: Load secrets from env; DEBUG off; explicit hosts. Development defaults are unsafe in production.

nodes.label: Django Expert Skill
nodes.rationale: Keeps SKILL.md short (<5k words) and loads detailed reference files on demand by task type.

nodes.label: Mandatory TDD Workflow (django-tdd)
nodes.rationale: Tests are written before implementation (Red-Green-Refactor), covering models, forms, views, templates and integration.

nodes.label: Django built-in test runner (R8)
nodes.rationale: pytest-django rejected as a new dependency with little gain.

nodes.label: Red-Green-Refactor Cycle
nodes.rationale: Write failing test first, make it pass, then refactor with tests green; project CLAUDE.md mandates this for every feature.

nodes.label: Documentation Map (CLAUDE.md, docs/index.md, architecture.md, database.md, admin.md, docs/apps/<name>.md)
nodes.norm_label: documentation map (claude.md, docs/index.md, architecture.md, database.md, admin.md, docs/apps/<name>.md)

nodes.rationale: Keeps CLAUDE.md and docs/ onboarding-grade after every code change so a newcomer can understand the system without asking; only edits .md files.
